request.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Treat the input as a reference for dimensional paper craft only. Radically reimagine the Buki home screen in a softer premium felt-and-ribbon direction. Put the exact word "Buki" on a small stitched fabric label near the top center. Replace the green line and flower with a looping woven ribbon that passes behind the label and ends in a layered rosette knot, clearly a new brand symbol. Build the main blank portrait sketchpad as a slightly asymmetric felt-backed page with six chunky mint loops at the top, a dashed inner artwork-safe frame, subtle square-dot grid, scalloped bottom paper edge, and two tasteful fabric patches outside the art zone. Palette: berry #D85691, mint #7FD4BE, plum #5B4075, peach #FFAE83, lilac #B79CE6, cream #FFF6EA. Camera control is a stitched berry fabric button near the bottom. Childy, cozy, premium, contemporary, uncluttered and implementable. Exact readable text only "Buki"; blank page; no phone frame, no other words, no giant bear, no realistic environment.
